name: ElegantFin TV
description: TV theme with reduced effects and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Reduce card shadows, focus zoom and layout transitions; use opaque navigation headers in the balanced TV profile. Correct image-size and main-thread diagnostic labels. Desktop CSS is unchanged.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
